artifact.summary: Abstaining: the specification fixes no concrete instance format and no paper-specific reduction. The two-level matrices, their Clifford+T implementations, the ancilla construction and the global-phase handling are all missing. Any circuit generated from this would be an invented construction, not the paper's method.

equation_mapping.explanation: Describes the ring Z[i,1/sqrt2] from which the input matrix entries come. No code was generated, and the matrix input format was not specified.
Unitarity is a precondition on the operator to be synthesized. No code was generated to check it.
The 1-/2-level decomposition has no specified choice of factors or ordering, and no ring-valued reduction procedure is given. Implementing it would require inventing the method.
The O(k) gate bound is an asymptotic claim with no constants. It is not an operation that can be built as a circuit.
The two-level elimination step is generic. The paper's specific E and its Clifford+T realization, including the ancilla use, are not given.

unresolved_issues: No concrete instance format or target unitary is defined.
The paper's two-level reduction and choice of two-level matrices are not specified.
The Clifford+T implementation of each factor is not specified.
The role and construction of the ancilla are not specified.
The constants in the O(k) bound are not specified.
